title: 你看不懂的那些潜规则
body: 成年人一定要明白，别人的答非所问，|就是不想说最真实的答案，|只不过不想让你尴尬，|敬而远之就是，不想跟你有过多交集，|沉默不语和不回复，就是拒绝，|闪烁不定，就是在说谎，|忽冷忽热，就是你偶尔有点用，但又不是很有用。
en: Grown-ups need to read the unspoken. When someone answers a question with something else, they are avoiding the truth — only sparing you embarrassment. Keeping their distance means they want no more involvement. Silence and no reply mean no. Hesitation means a lie. Hot one day, cold the next — it means you are occasionally useful, but not essential.
credit: 原作 卡尔·古斯塔夫·卡鲁斯（Carl Gustav Carus, 1789–1869）《晨雾（Morgennebel）》约1825 · 布面油画
